notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.9.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A new version of Escape from Pleasure Planet is now live. It contains several balance and stability fixes. It also fixes a really bad game breaking bad for some players involving monitors on the prison planet.

[*] add: lots of scripts for out-of-order sign later in game
[*] add: more tips when player stuck in queue of destruction quest
[*] add: rework crashed ship quest to make it slightly easier
[*] add: more scripts for final sequence
[*] add: log button to title screen to provide better support
[*] add: easier to exit non-core generated pods
 
[*] change: new build process for linux and windows to improve support
[*] change: streamline various conversations when revisiting them
[*] change: improved logging
[*] change: improved walkthrough generation
[*] change: streamline conversations in final sequence
[*] change: rework boner portrait
 
[*] fix: game breaking bug in monitor quest on prison planet on some computers 
[*] fix: name display issue when name is empty string
[*] fix: a few portrait fixes for MIS-TRISS and Brutus' ship
[/list]

notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.6 - "Hawking"
notes.content:
The latest version of Escape from Pleasure Planet is now live. This release is mostly a bit of polish to balance the game, tighten some dialogue and to give the player more freedom to explore.

Escape from Pleasure Planet is a gay sci-fi adventure game from the writer of the award-winning Miss Fisher and the Deathly Maze game and with character art by comic book legend Joe Phillips.

[b]1.6 - Hawking - changelog[/b] 
[list]
    [*]add look and interact scripts for monorail shuttle
    [*]add sfx for shuttle
    [*]add interact script on butterfly in astatue
    [*]add conversation with crashed ship in astatue
    [*]add ability for player to interact with tourists in foyer
    [*]add new music to queue of destruction sequence
    [*]add lights to transmat control
    [*]add better hint on blood in queue of destruction
    [*]add shadow to Bazzarella in queue of destruction
    [*]add ding sfx when entering queue of destruction
    [*]add shadow to table in queue of destruction
    [*]add achievement for trying to take bag
    [*]add extra scripts when carrying empty perfume bottle
    [*]add new sfx to transmat
    [*]add more interact and look scripts for jigsaw puzzle combinations
    [*]add interact and look script for transmat laser
    [*]add extra tips to loading screen messages
    [*]add mouse restriction when inventory open
    [*]add sfx and music to pyglet-based sound mixer (experimental)
    [*]change queue text in minor ways
    [*]change puzzle grid so that fades in and out when box opened and closed
    [*]change statue pleasure planet dialogue to hopefully be funnier
    [*]change transmat so player is asked if they want to activate it
    [*]change to give player choice of what to do with astronaut 2
    [*]change to swap butterfly look and interact scripts
    [*]change queue lab door to interactive while there is a queue
    [*]change Bazzarella luggage gag to only play once
    [*]change pyglet to 1.3.1
    [*]fix a bunch of portrait issues when Tycho in fountain
    [*]fix mouse events in mouse exclusive mode on Windows (pyglet 1.3.1)
    [*]fix to respect keyboard layout on macOS (pyglet 1.3.1)
[/list]

notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.5 - "Taika Waititi"
notes.content:
Pleased to release a new version of the game. This is a balance and bugfix update. 

New features include better support for dual monitors, distance scaling and a new button in the inventory for inspecting items. 

Balance changes include a nerf to the care bear puzzle in the sky pod, additional scripts in the opening crash site scene and making the tmat quest clearer in some circumstances.

Keeping true to the science fiction genre, Escape from Pleasure Planet tackles sensitive contemporary issues such government oppression of gay people, the cruelty of conversion therapy, and the benefits and negatives of same sex marriage on gay culture.
                    [list]
                        [*]add look button to inventory to inspect items[/*]
                        [*]add setting to allow player to set default screen in multi-screen setups[/*]
                        [*]add z-scaling to scenes[/*]
                        [*]add Dream Daddy joke to loading screen[/*]
                        [*]add extra interact scripts in lab[/*]
                        [*]add extra interact scripts at crash site[/*]
                        [*]add ESC hotkey to menu[/*]
                        [*]add subtle distance scaling to walk area at crash site[/*]
                        [*]change care bear puzzle to make dramatically easier[/*]
                        [*]change tmat quest to make logic stronger and have better clues[/*]
                        [*]change various edits to text to tighten up sections and make a few jokes land better[/*]
                        [*]change menu items only interactive is interactive flag is set[/*]
                        [*]change scene loading for faster loads[/*]
                        [*]change pyglet to 1.3.0 official[/*]
                        [*]change cleanerbot story to advance after exiting sky pod[/*]
                        [*]fix achievement when scanning ship multiple times[/*]
                        [*]fix portrait of Tycho where he would sometimes wear older costume[/*]
                        [*]fix to improve pathplanning[/*]
                        [*]fix pathplanning for default action[/*]
                        [*]fix missing rumble sfx[/*]
                        [*]fix decorative mask scripts undressed portraits[/*]
                        [*]fix portraits when in fountain[/*]
                        [*]fix to mouse coordinates in full screen mode on dual monitors[/*]
                        [*]fix scene loading to correctly handle portals[/*]

notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.4 - "Cunliffe"
notes.content:
A new update for the game is now live. This release brings a focus on stability and speed.

It fixes some major issues that players have reported and should make the game buttery smooth for most people now.

Keeping true to the science fiction genre, Escape from Pleasure Planet tackles sensitive contemporary issues such government oppression of gay people, the cruelty of conversion therapy, and the benefits and negatives of same sex marriage on gay culture.

This release is dedicated to a friend of ours, Jim Cunliffe, who is unwell at the moment.

Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.4
[list]
[*][b]Fix major problem where game would slow down after many speech boxes[/b]
[*][b]Procedurally generated worlds no longer crash game on windows[/b]
[*][b]Fix joypad input bounding box on scaled game windows[/b]
[*]add missing art and animation for achievements
[*]fix interact bug on entering Sebastian's pod
[*]fix bug with Brutus text repeating when entering foyer
[*]force load on eyeball assets to fix "missing MIS-TRISS" issue in foyer
[*]various spelling and grammar fixes
[*]xian child script fixes
[*]pronoun fixes for Ludwig
[*]QNB options in later sequence a bit clearer
[*]add tips to game load screen
[*]fix menus to make compatible with older savegames
[*]add a few backwards compatible fixes for older savegames
[*]update CycleText to handle animated text better
[*]pyglet updated to v1.3.0rc1
[*]add editor option to config
[*]numpy pulled in correctly on windows build
[*]unschedule animated text events correctly
[*]allow Collection to be unsorted, Collection.add can take a list of items (for The Beat)
[*]add Text.align which can be set to LEFT (default), CENTER, RIGHT
[/list]

notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.3 - Accessibility Release
notes.content:
The new update for our game is now live. In addition to fixes and balance tweaks, this new release brings a focus on features that can assist players in the areas of vision, hearing. motor and cognitive tasks.

New features include a high contrast mode, subtitles, story mode, and ability to switch off events that require fast action. This release also adds more sound effects and text updates.

Keeping true to the science fiction genre, Escape from Pleasure Planet tackles sensitive topical issues such the Russian government’s oppression of gay people, the cruelty of conversion therapy, and the benefits and negatives of same sex marriage on gay culture.

notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.2 - codename "Valentine"
notes.content:
Hearty new update for the game is now live. In addition to fixes and balance tweaks, this new release adds a romantic alternative ending that only unlocks once a year around Valentine's Day.

Keeping true to the science fiction genre, [i]Escape from Pleasure Planet[/i] tackles sensitive topical issues such the Russian government’s oppression of gay people, the problems of conversion therapy, and the benefits and negatives of same sex marriage on gay culture.

Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.2 - "Valentine"

[list]
[*] add: alternate ending that unlocks once a year around Valentine's Day
[*] add: additional scripts in Faith pod
[*] add: new names for items in Chip's locker
[*] add: additional scripts on Elysium when Tycho is bathing
[*] add: additional scripts on Panoptica
[*] add: configuration utility (currently requires python installed)
[*] add: additional scripts in later scene
[*] add: i18n - basic locale support for translations in data/locale
[*] add: scale up game window in non fullscreen mode if requested
[*] add: font adjust available using F5 and F6 keys
[*] add: new camera zoom function (used in alternative ending)
[*] add: mod support -- load montage files from mod directory
[*] add: pyglet mixer stub alternative to pygame mixer
[*] change: save directory is now game independent
[*] change: updated MIS-TRISS art
[*] change: updated Boner art
[*] change: new coords load into ship terminal immediately
[*] change: make menu creation immediate for away missions
[*] change: pause game for a few seconds when using butterfly on bluebells
[*] change: universe seed changes each new game
[*] change: bicorder exit no longer allowed in later scene
[*] change: build includes source code in-place instead of source/
[*] change: fonts loaded at runtime to allow multi-language support
[*] fix: menu offset was incorrect when starting new game
[*] fix: star field correctly scales when window scaled
[*] fix: show menu after return from Eden pod
[*] fix: bicorder no longer changes when holding butterfly
[*] fix: stop butterflies being attracted to Tycho if he is in brook
[*] fix: Chip's locker quest works when using both left and right room combinations
[*] fix: bicorder allows exit in non-core pods after character exit
[*] fix: added missing melted sorbet files
[/list]

notes.title: Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.1 - "Princess"
notes.content:
Delicious new update for the game is now live. Fixes a few issues, balances a few sections, runs faster.

[h1]Escape from Pleasure Planet v1.1 ("Princess")[h1]
[list]
    [*]load game: games load faster, display animated messages to player
    [*]load game screen: scroll buttons work
    [*]new games: start much faster
    [*]new games: display animated loading messaging
    [*]title screen: title music no longer restarts after selecting "new game"
    [*]travel: Enter in a VIP planet destination number crashes/closes. FIXED but on windows some landscaping and plants might be missing depending on planet.
    [*]fullscreen: rewrote window creation code to better handle different resolutions and fullscreen mode.
    [*]fullscreen: game now requires a restart if toggling fullscreen mode
    [*]fullscreen: --fullscreen toggles instead of forces fullscreen
    [*]engine: actor image paths are stored unix style
    [*]engine: fix to load game when resident scenes don't exist
    [*]engine: menu objects obey same event rules as scene objects to reduce queuing events from menu items
    [*]mod: game engine will try and pick up replacement files from the mod/ directory.
    [*]terminal: possible fix to coord problem where destination does not appear 
    [*]lab2: fix to lab2 if qnb is the convo trigger
    [*]lab2: fix butterfly message if character is not available
    [*]transmat: fix to transmat when player has changed coords in terminal but not travelled
    [*]transmat: fix bug that stopped player walking to queue scene.
    [*]transmat: Better message when using coin on out-of-order sign.
    [*]statues: After being introduced to all founders, update the names on the statues
    [*]arcadian: When using a new card, Tycho now mentions he's removing the previous card
    [*]arcadian: Extra clue when caught twice on the 3rd cherry
    [*]float: removed ability to stack clicks on jetpack
    [*]eden: Remove ability to use Bug on landed butterfly.
    [*]eden: Mention butterfly not interested in red flower when clicking on flowers
    [*]eden: More references to blue dye and blue flowers
    [*]eden: Fixed: Tycho can reenter beach after Brutus has left 
    [*]eden: sorbet now melts to give an extra clue and can't be collected until breakup
    [*]eden: fix to blue lagoon drift motion
    [*]eden: fix to butterfly bluebell motion
    [*]eden: player can trigger lagoon dye in any order without causing graphical issues
    [*]eden: butterfly can't be collected until needed
    [*]xian: Bug text change after tomb is opened
    [*]general: added a few more non-essential interactions and use cases for combining objects
[/list]
